cd /workspace/task && cat > fill.py << 'EOF'
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Contact List']
ws['J4'] = '=IF(AND(H4>=TODAY()-30,I4="YES"),"HOLD",IF(AND(H4<TODAY()-30,I4="YES"),"TOUCH BASE","NO ACTION"))'
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print("done")
EOF
